I replied to Marcus in the DM to say I'll keep the possible move to Door 23 between us. I told them I won't repeat it in any channel or to anyone else, and I won't treat it as confirmed.

The store is Pine Crossing. A June 9 #central-team chat in the GBrain notes says its morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and I named the store in my reply.

I didn't save the rumor to GBrain or memory, and I didn't post or send it anywhere else.
